statement.zh: **事件**：DSA 数字签名标准（Digital Signature Standard）。本行登记的留存件是 FIPS 186-5：公告第 1 条把标准命名为 Digital Signature Standard (DSS)，并自陈为 186-5 修订版（fips186-5.txt:35）；这条名称句把名称、类别与说明挤在同一行里，因此放在引号外陈述。标准做的事印在第 35 行：「This standard specifies algorithms for applications requiring a digital signature rather than a written signature.」（本标准为需要数字签名而非手写签名的应用规定算法）。让任何人都能验签的那组不对称关系在下一行：「Signature generation uses a private key to generate a digital signature; signature verification uses a public key that corresponds to but is not the same as the private key.」（签名生成用私钥产生数字签名；签名验证使用与私钥相对应但并不相同的公钥）；该行后半还说公钥可以为公众所知、私钥必须保密，只有持有私钥者才能执行签名生成。
statement.en: **Event**: Digital Signature Standard.It is registered under digital signatures, dated 1991.

statement.zh: 标准自己给出存在理由，而且给了两次——一次在摘要（fips186-5.txt:23），一次几乎逐字重述在第 49 行的 Applications 条款。它要买到的性质是 「Digital signatures are used to detect unauthorized modifications to data and to authenticate the identity of the signatory.」（数字签名用于检出数据被未授权修改，并认证签署者身份）；而那一收束句解释了为什么签名值得被标准化、而不只是被实现：「This is known as non-repudiation since the signatory cannot easily repudiate the signature at a later time.」（这被称为不可否认性，因为签署者事后难以轻易否认该签名）。它为什么是一份 FIPS 而非一篇论文，答案在第 48 行第 6 条：「This standard shall be used in designing and implementing public key-based signature systems that federal departments and agencies operate or that are operated for them under contract.
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in digital signatures, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 对本行而言，起作用的边界来自标准自身的撤回，而登记的这份修订版把它说了两遍。第 438 行那个以 The Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) 为标题的说明节，在第 439 行写道：「Prior versions of this standard specified the DSA.This standard no longer approves the DSA for digital signature generation.」（本标准的早期版本规定过 DSA；本标准不再核准 DSA 用于数字签名生成）。核准一节的表述更具体，见第 124 行：「The Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) is no longer specified in this standard and may only be used to verify previously generated digital signatures.」（数字签名算法 DSA 已不再由本标准规定，只能用于验证先前已生成的数字签名）；同一行的下一句把读者支往别处：「Complete specifications may be found in Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 186-4 [7].」（完整规定可在 FIPS 186-4 中找到）。因此在这份登记件内部，目录行所命名算法只以可验证的能力留存，其参数已不再印出。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.
